data.one_liner: Encapsulates a Stream<T> with its latest value and load state.
data.what_it_does: It provides an interface that exposes a Stream<T>, the most recent value emitted, and a flag indicating whether a value has been loaded. The package also offers widgets that simplify displaying progress indicators while waiting for the first value.
use_when: Need to access the latest stream value outside of a listen callback
Want to avoid flickering when rebuilding widgets after a rotation
Need a simple way to show a loading indicator until a stream emits its first value
avoid_when: Using multi-subscription streams that require immediate subscription
When you need to transform or combine streams with complex logic that is better handled by other stream utilities
strengths: Easy access to the latest value without manual state management
Built-in widgets reduce boilerplate for loading states
weaknesses: Does not automatically subscribe to the stream; the first value is only available after a subscription
No built-in support for stream transformations or combinators
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import the package; no special permissions or build_runner needed
